comment:
* A segment of a buffer. * *

Each segment in a buffer is a circularly-linked list node referencing the following and * preceding segments in the buffer. * *

Each segment in the pool is a singly-linked list node referencing the rest of segments in the * pool. * *

The underlying byte arrays of segments may be shared between buffers and byte strings. When a * segment's byte array is shared the segment may not be recycled, nor may its byte data be changed. * The lone exception is that the owner segment is allowed to append to the segment, writing data at * {@code limit} and beyond. There is a single owning segment for each byte array. Positions, * limits, prev, and next references are not shared.

variables.name: SIZE
variables.comment: The size of all segments in bytes.

variables.name: pos
variables.comment: The next byte of application data byte to read in this segment.

variables.name: limit
variables.comment: The first byte of available data ready to be written to.

variables.name: shared
variables.comment: True if other segments or byte strings use the same byte array.

variables.name: owner
variables.comment: True if this segment owns the byte array and can append to it, extending {@code limit}.

variables.name: next
variables.comment: Next segment in a linked or circularly-linked list.

variables.name: prev
variables.comment: Previous segment in a circularly-linked list.

methods.name: public Segment pop()
methods.comment:
* Removes this segment of a circularly-linked list and returns its successor.
   * Returns null if the list is now empty.

methods.name: public Segment push(Segment segment)
methods.comment:
* Appends {@code segment} after this segment in the circularly-linked list.
   * Returns the pushed segment.

methods.name: public Segment split(int byteCount)
methods.comment:
* Splits this head of a circularly-linked list into two segments. The first * segment contains the data in {@code [pos..pos+byteCount)}. The second * segment contains the data in {@code [pos+byteCount..limit)}. This can be * useful when moving partial segments from one buffer to another. * *

Returns the new head of the circularly-linked list.

methods.name: public void compact()
methods.comment:
* Call this when the tail and its predecessor may both be less than half
   * full. This will copy data so that segments can be recycled.

methods.name: public void writeTo(Segment sink, int byteCount)
methods.comment: Moves {@code byteCount} bytes from this segment to {@code sink}.

methodNames: public void writeTo(Segment sink, int byteCount)
